title: have ork compare the diff hash with the previous round's and state "tree unchanged since round N" in the brief, so a resumed gate does not need to re-derive it

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The gate reported this as tool feedback (deterministic-check) on ork in ork run ork-20261118-035228-7421, project ork, item S403:
have ork compare the diff hash with the previous round's and state "tree unchanged since round N" in the brief, so a resumed gate does not need to re-derive it
Evidence: implementer-2 changed no file; the gate had to re-run git status, git diff --stat and a grep of cited lines to confirm the 12-file 829/144 diff was unchanged

Evidence (2026-11-18):

- A resumed role's brief has a Resumed session section that tells it to run git status and git diff again and re-read every cited file, and shows `git status --porcelain` at the round's start (`internal/engine/brief.go:165-172`, filled at `internal/engine/round.go:594-606`). It says nothing about whether the content changed since the role last looked.
- ork already fingerprints the tree after each implementer round: `endImplement` stores `TreeSHA256` on the implementer's row (`internal/engine/states.go:321-335`), used by `noProgress` (`internal/engine/states.go:182-200`) and `TreeMatchesLastRound` (`internal/engine/resume.go:228-256`).
- That fingerprint hashes `git diff HEAD --binary` and the untracked file names only (`internal/engine/round.go:150-160`). A slice's new files are untracked until the commit, so an edit inside a new file does not change it. A brief that says "unchanged" on this hash alone could be wrong; this slice needs a fingerprint that also covers untracked file content.
- A read-only role cannot change the tree (adj 28, `role.readonly-fingerprint`), so the tree a resumed reviewer or gate last judged is the tree at the start of its previous round.

Open owner question: whether the brief, when the tree is unchanged, also drops the instruction to re-run git status and git diff, or only adds the fact. Per the owner's answer to `brief.tree-unchanged`.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/engine/round.go:150-160` (`treeContent`; a new full-content fingerprint beside it)
- `internal/engine/round.go:590-606` (record the fingerprint at a read-only round's start; compare on a resumed round)
- `internal/engine/brief.go:28-52` (`BriefInput`: the round the tree is unchanged since)
- `internal/engine/brief.go:164-173` (Resumed session section)
- `internal/runrec/record.go` (the role row's start fingerprint, `omitempty`)
- `internal/engine/brief_test.go`
- `internal/engine/engine_test.go`
- `docs/design.md` (Roles: the resumed brief)
- `docs/state.md` (the new run record field)

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
Owner decision adj 490 (`brief.tree-unchanged` = state, 2026-11-18): state the fact, drop the git status and git diff re-run, keep re-reading every cited file.

- `TestTreeFullContentSeesAnUntrackedEdit` in `internal/engine/engine_test.go`: in a git worktree with one untracked file, the full-content fingerprint changes when the file's content changes and its name does not. Red today: no such function; `treeContent` gives the same hash for both trees.
- `TestResumedGateBriefSaysTreeUnchanged` in `internal/engine/engine_test.go`: a run where the gate ran in round 2, the implementer in round 3 changed no file, and the gate is resumed in round 3; its brief says "The tree is unchanged since round 2, when you last reported." Red today: the brief has no such line.
- `TestResumedGateBriefOmitsUnchangedAfterAnEdit`: the same run, but round 3's implementer edits an untracked new file; the brief has no unchanged line. Red only against a fingerprint without file content; it guards step 2.
- `TestResumedBriefWithoutStartFingerprintOmitsUnchanged`: a run record from before this slice (no start fingerprint on the earlier row) gets no unchanged line and no error. Green today; it guards old records.
- `TestResumedBriefUnchangedLine` in `internal/engine/brief_test.go`: `BuildBrief` with `Resumed` and the unchanged round set prints the line in the Resumed session section, drops the instruction to re-run git status and git diff, and keeps the instruction to re-read every file it cites (adj 490). Without the unchanged round set, the section is as today. Red today.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the failing tests and see them red for the stated reason.
2. Add a full-content fingerprint beside `treeContent`: `git diff HEAD --binary`, plus each untracked file's name and content, read with git (for example `git hash-object` on the names from `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z`) or from disk. Do not change `treeContent` or `TreeSHA256`, which `noProgress` and `TreeMatchesLastRound` compare against older records.
3. At the start of each reviewer, gate and architect round, store the fingerprint on that role's row (new `omitempty` field in `internal/runrec/record.go`). Reuse the git calls the read-only fingerprint already makes where possible.
4. On a resumed round of one of those roles, compare the current fingerprint with the one on the role's previous row. Equal: set `BriefInput` to that row's round. Missing or different: leave it unset.
5. `BuildBrief`: in the Resumed session section, print "The tree is unchanged since round N, when you last reported." when the round is set. When it is set, drop the instruction to re-run git status and git diff (adj 490); keep the instruction to re-read every file it cites.
6. Docs: `docs/design.md` (resumed brief, citing adj 490) and `docs/state.md` (the new field). Changelog entry with `slicer changelog add S424 --text "..."`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- A resumed reviewer, gate or architect whose tree did not change since its last report is told so, with that round's number, and is not told to re-run git status and git diff (adj 490).
- An edit inside an untracked new file counts as a change.
- A run record written before this slice still resumes, with no unchanged line.
- The existing tree fingerprint and its comparisons are unchanged.

Commands:
- `go test ./internal/engine -run 'TreeFullContent|TreeUnchanged|OmitsUnchanged|UnchangedLine|WithoutStartFingerprint' -v`
- `go vet ./...`
- `go test ./...`
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- `slicer check` exits 0.
- `adj lint` exits 0.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch, message "S424: tell a resumed gate when the tree is unchanged since its last round".
